note: Curated by gene SYMBOL only. All accession IDs, sequences and hashes are resolved live by fetch_sequences.py from Ensembl REST + UniProt REST and pinned in sequence_links.json. No accession is hand-written here, so nothing can silently rot or be invented.

claim_boundary.sequence_gives_you: Gene/transcript/protein identity, isoform, CDS + protein sequence, length, GC/codon composition, mature-ligand size, ortholog identity. From protein size you can derive a RELATIVE diffusion prior D ~ MW^(-1/3) (Stokes-Einstein scaling) for ranking morphogens against each other.
claim_boundary.sequence_does_not_give_you: Absolute diffusion coefficients, production/degradation rates, receptor affinities, or expression timing/place. Those are kinetic and regulatory facts: they must come from the cited literature / expression atlases (ZFIN, Xenbase, FlyBase, WormBase) and belong in the model script, not in the sequence record.
claim_boundary.therefore: A sequence link EMULATES a named biological morphogen (right molecule, right species, right isoform, comparable size/diffusion ranking); it does not by itself parameterise a reaction-diffusion simulation.

entries.why: Zebrafish BMP2b (swirl) is the dorsal-ventral BMP gradient ligand; canonical activator-side morphogen for RD emulation.
Chordin (dino) is the secreted BMP antagonist - the inhibitor partner a BMP activator needs for a two-morphogen Turing pair.
Sonic hedgehog a: long-range graded signalling (neural tube, fin/limb), cholesterol/palmitate-modified so its effective diffusion is membrane-tethered - a useful contrast to freely-diffusing BMP.
Fgf8a (acerebellar): midbrain-hindbrain organiser gradient; classic Wolpert positional-information morphogen.
her1 is the somitogenesis segmentation-clock oscillator - pairs with clock-wavefront models rather than steady Turing patterns.
Xenopus Bmp4: ventralising BMP in the classic Spemann-organiser DV gradient, directly relevant to this repo's Xenopus bioelectric/craniofacial work.
Noggin: the Spemann-organiser BMP antagonist - the inhibitor half of the best-characterised vertebrate morphogen pair (BMP/Noggin).
Xenopus Shh for pairing a named hedgehog ligand with the repo's bioelectric-morphogen coupling models.
Decapentaplegic is Drosophila BMP: the wing-disc morphogen whose gradient positions veins - direct link to the wing-venation models in models/.
Wingless is Drosophila Wnt1: short-range, lipid-modified Wnt gradient - contrasts with long-range Dpp in the same tissue.
Hedgehog: the original segment-polarity morphogen, upstream inducer of dpp/wg - useful as the source term in coupled-gradient emulations.
LIN-44/Wnt polarises cells along the C. elegans AP axis - named Wnt for the WormGUIDES cell-lineage model already in the repo.
MAB-5 is the C. elegans Antennapedia-class Hox factor: not a diffusible morphogen but the downstream positional-identity readout a gradient emulation should terminate in.
Mouse Bmp4 for limb-bud RD emulation alongside Limbform - mammalian ortholog to compare against zebrafish bmp2b / Xenopus bmp4 diffusion priors.
Mouse Shh: the zone-of-polarising-activity limb morphogen - the digit-patterning gradient for limb models.

KIT is the counter-evidence gene named in datasets/bos_taurus_turing_wavelength/README.md: cattle white spotting tracks melanoblast migration (KIT/MITF), not a Turing pre-pattern. Linking its real sequence anchors that negative claim to a molecule.
MITF: master melanocyte transcription factor, second half of the KIT/MITF spotting account contrasted with the Murray (1981) Turing claim in this repo.
